name: ruff-quality
description: Teaches Claude the current Ruff workflow for Python (safe fixes, format, check; configuration discovery; rule selection after Ruff 0.16; migration from Black, isort, and Flake8; pre-commit and CI), and, only when you ask and choose a scope and a configuration, installs Claude Code hooks that fix, format, and lint every Python file Claude edits, deny suppression comments and configuration changes, and keep Claude from finishing until the files are clean.
